description: 1. The agent must read `selective-memory/SKILL.md` to understand the required file structure. 2. It must create `selective-memory/memory/` directory and initialize all four files: `wisdom.md`, `goals.md`, `mistakes.md`, `preferences.md`. 3. It must parse `agent_ops/logs/interaction_log_2024_03.txt` and apply the skill's automatic learning rules: EVENT-001 (23 upvotes, long-form) and EVENT-006 (14 upvotes, tutorial) both exceed the >10 threshold and must go to preferences.md as long-form content insights; EVENT-002 (0 engagement) must go to mistakes.md; EVENT-003 (constructive feedback) must go to wisdom.md; EVENT-005 (rate limit hit) must go to mistakes.md; EVENT-008 (community insight) must go to wisdom.md or preferences.md; EVENT-009 (new goal) must go to goals.md; EVENT-011 (cross-platform adaptation) must go to preferences.md; EVENT-012 (valid criticism about source verification) must go to mistakes.md; EVENT-015 (principle about clarifying questions) must go to wisdom.md. 4. CRITICAL FILTER: The agent must NOT save EVENT-004 (temporary emotion/mood), EVENT-007 (unverified rumor), EVENT-010 (toxic comment), or EVENT-013 (trivial interaction) — these are explicitly forbidden by the SKILL.md's SKIP rules. 5. All entries must use bullet-point format (`- entry`). The proprietary trap is the exact engagement thresholds (>10 for preferences vs 0 for mistakes) and the explicit noise/toxic filtering requirements that a generic agent won't apply correctly without reading the SKILL.md.
